Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 89. Category: form. Ancient Super Saiyan.

Transformation
You gain the full strength of your dark ki combined
with your Super Saiyan State. Awakening an enhanced
version of Super Saiyan 3 with red eyes as opposed to
blue eyes and a darkened ki. You must have the “Dark
Ki” Power-Up Active in order to transform
+4 Power
+1d10 Damage
+20 movement speed
When you would cast a technique, you may spend an
amount of stamina equal to half the ki rank,
changing the damage type to necrotic.
drains 5 Stamina at the end of your turn
